news.title: Telling question Hull boss asked Herrington after galling penalty miss
news.lede: Exclusive: When Hull coach Sergej Jakirović sat down to watch the Socceroos’ round of 32 World Cup clash with Egypt, he was paying careful attention to a player he would manage within a month. This was Australia’s only match Jakirović watched during the World Cup. Hull City manager Sergej Jakirović. It just so happened to be the day an 18-year-old Lucas Herrington stepped up for a crucial penalty.

news.title: Thomas Tuchel's intensive World Cup inquest as FA prepare major report into England failings
news.lede: The FA have carried out an inquest with England manager Thomas Tuchel to assess exactly what went wrong in the Three Lions' agonising World Cup semi-final loss to Argentina . On paper, the summer competition in the USA, Mexico and Canada was the country's second-best showing in the competition. The 6-4 win over France in the third-place play-off meant Tuchel, technically, led England to their greatest campaign since the 1966 triumph. However, it felt anything but jubilant, due to the Three Lions allowing a 1-0 lead to slip through their hands before losing to two quick-fire goals against the Argentinians.

news.title: World Cup winner Llorente retires from Spain duty at 31
news.lede: World Cup winner Marcos Llorente announced his retirement from international football on Thursday, ending a Spain career that yielded 27 caps. The Atletico Madrid defender, 31, made his senior team debut for Spain in 2020 and was part of the squad that beat Argentina 1-0 to win the World Cup in July, although he remained on the bench in the final. "I realise that I’m still young and that, perhaps, if I continued to perform well, I’d still have years left to play in this jersey," Llorente wrote on Instagram. "I know many of you won’t understand this, and I probably wouldn’t have understood it either if I were looking at it from the outside.
